title: Longest Nice Subarray
goal: Find the longest subarray whose different elements have pairwise disjoint set bits.
strategy: Within a valid window each set bit belongs to at most one element. Its OR mask detects conflicts with the next value; removing an element with XOR is safe because its bits are unique inside the window.
